subject: Metaserve private deployment playbook & staging sprint
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex@metaserve.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Metaserve private deployment playbook & staging sprint

Alex — attaching the initial playbook draft and a proposed 2-week staging sprint cadence. Key asks in this note:
- Confirm staging window (we've tentatively blocked 7/10 - 7/21 PT)
- Confirm whether Metaserve wants VPC peering or PrivateLink-style endpoints in the first cut
- Any firewall/egress ACL contacts we should add to the call

Attachments: metaserve-playbook-v1.pdf, metaserve-staging-sprint-calendar.xlsx

Quick overview (TL;DR):
- Week 0: runbook handoff, preflight checklist, credential exchange (KMS scope)
- Week 1: staging connectivity (peering / endpoints), service smoke tests, KV cache warmup
- Week 2: performance ramp, SLO verification, rollback/runbook rehearsals

I'm looping Marissa and Ben to coordinate networking and the on-prem package checklist. If this aligns, we'll post the final playbook and send calendar invites for the preflight meeting next Wed.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Johnson <alex@metaserve.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: DevOps Team <devops@metaserve.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-25T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Metaserve private deployment playbook & staging sprint

Jordan — thanks for this. The draft is helpful. Quick points from our side:
- 7/10-7/21 looks okay but we need to reserve 7/12 for a customer demo (can shift smoke tests).
- We prefer VPC peering for the first rollout; PrivateLink endpoints are possible later for tighter isolation.
- Firewall team contact: Priya Rao (priya.rao@metaserve.io) — cc'ing general DevOps for intake.

A couple of security callouts:
- We will need the exact list of KMS key prefixes that Redwood will use for envelope encryption so our SEC team can pre-approve.
- Audit logging: can Redwood include token-level request IDs in the delivered logs for our SIEM?

Attaching a short internal note from our infra team (summary only).

—Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Cloud Engineering, Metaserve

Date: 2028-06-26T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Metaserve private deployment playbook & staging sprint — networking readiness

Adding network implementation details and a couple of asks for Metaserve prior to preflight: 
1) Peering preference noted — we'll treat peering as primary. For the preflight please provide: VPC CIDR ranges (primary + any secondary), desired peering route propagation, and expected egress IP ranges for third-party vendors.
2) On BGP/Direct Connect: if you plan to test cross-region BGP, flag it now so we can provision the edge appliance in the right AZs.
3) Private endpoints: we'll stage them behind a NAT gateway if you need outbound-only traffic; otherwise we'll map them to ENIs for full two-way connectivity.

I've attached our preflight checklist (redwood-preflight-checklist.docx) and a short network diagram template.

Proposed: preflight review call on 2028-07-03 10:00 PT — 30m. Jordan, can you confirm and I'll send invites to Priya.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Principal Network Solutions, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex@metaserve.io>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-27T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Metaserve private deployment playbook & staging sprint — runbook + on‑prem package

Hi all — attaching a runbook stub and an outline for the on-prem package we will ship if Metaserve opts for the hybrid appliance path. Top-level notes:
- Runbook contains explicit cutover steps, rollback triggers, and the smoke-test checklist (service-level, health-check endpoints, token validation).
- On-prem package: container image + orchestration manifest, health probes, and a small telemetry agent. We'll need an EULA addendum for appliance install on your side (legal already prepping).
- For the VPC peering path: we will require a connectivity test account (IAM role) from Metaserve with read-only route table visibility for the preflight tests. Please send role arn: or let us create a cross-account role that you approve.

Important networking parameters to agree before we finalize the playbook: 
- MTU expectations (we default to 1500, but can adapt to 9000 on request)
- DNS resolution approach (private hosted zone vs. split-horizon)
- Whether your SIEM requires token-level or summary logs (Alex — you flagged this)

I've attached: redwood-runbook-stub.md (inline summary in body), redwood-preflight-checklist.docx (again), and onprem-package-outline.pdf

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Manager, Customer Implementation — Redwood Inference

Thanks, team — this is great. Quick responses: 
- Priya (firewall) confirmed the CIDR ranges and will drop a spreadsheet by EOD tomorrow.
- We'll provision the cross-account role; Alex T. (cc'd) from infra will share the ARN and scope.
- Token-level request IDs are fine — send the log schema and sample fields and we'll loop in SIEM.

Confirming the 2028-07-03 10:00 PT preflight review call works for Metaserve. Please send the calendar invite and include the runbook as the call artifact.

Appreciate the clarity — looking forward to the sprint.

—Alex
